whatToWatch.text: Seahawks (0-0) host the New England Patriots.
Vegas has this at SEA -3.5, total 44.5.
Both defenses are getting after it early: Seattle's averaging 2.8 sacks/game, New England Patriots 2.1.
Seattle's injury report: 5 out, 0 questionable (Amari Kight, Aaron Smith, Power Echols).

newsBlurb.text: Trevon Diggs picked off a pass in his first game in Seattle and says he's ready to help this team win — a nice opening statement before the Patriots come to town. Jalen Milroe closed the preseason with his sharpest outing, while Jason Myers' uncharacteristically rough kicking in the 9-9 tie with Kansas City is the loose thread nobody wants unraveling in a tight one. With the roster freshly trimmed, this is the first real look at what Seattle actually built.
